why_separate: These are BID changes, not budget changes. One lands on an ENABLED campaign (24132507744) and raises cost per click, so it carries its own approval.
bidding_strategy_unchanged: All campaigns stay on TARGET_SPEND (Maximize Clicks) with a CPC ceiling. No conversion-based Smart Bidding, because the primary-conversion and attribution signals are still unreliable: the website phone number is wrong, the positive-path GCLID test is incomplete, and no approved production form test has been run.

changes.campaign: Search | NonBrand | Heating Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-09
changes.evidence: Pre-ceiling clearing prices: furnace p50 $23.04 / p75 $42.19 (161 clicks); heating_generic p50 $20.43 / p75 $37.48 (1,413 clicks). Account search-term CPCs: Furnace Repair $41.70, Heating Repair $10.35. $42 sits at the furnace p75, high enough to take three quarters of the auctions this theme has historically cleared, without chasing the $59.95-$63.50 p90 tail set under uncapped Maximize Clicks. Replaces the old $38.

changes.campaign: Search | NonBrand | Heating Installation | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-09
changes.evidence: Installation clicks are the most expensive non-boiler heating clicks in the account: Furnace Replacement $45.97, Furnace Installation $45.39, oil furnace installation $28.22, furnace p75 $42.19. changes.campaign: Search | NonBrand | Gas Boiler Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
changes.evidence: The most expensive heating theme in the account. Generic boiler p50 $29.83 / p75 $55.80 (265 clicks); gas boiler p50 $87.75, mean $98.87 (160 clicks); account search-term CPCs Boiler Repair $59.32, Boiler Maintenance $75.08, Boiler Installation $47.76. $60 clears the generic-boiler p75 and the account boiler-repair CPC, and sits deliberately BELOW the gas-boiler prices because those were set under uncapped Maximize Clicks. Evidence the current $25 is binding: this ENABLED campaign has bought ONE click all season ($12.84) and is losing 31.2% of impression share to budget with 6.2% to rank.
